sentences.text: Misc .
Criminal Case No. 29259 of 2025

Mohd. Jakir
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri L N Soni, Senior Advocate along with Shri Dipesh 
 Advocate for the applicant.
Shri K K Tiwari-GA appearing on behalf of Advocate Gen  ORDER 1] They are heard.
Perused the case diary/challan papers.

2] This is the second bail applications filed by applicant under Section 483 BHARTIYA NAGRIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023/ section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.149/2024 registered at Police Station M.G.
Road, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 474,
120-B, and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text:
Police Station M.G.
Road, District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 3.5.2024.
3] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the appliant is aged 50 years and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that the other co-accused persons have already been granted bail by this Court.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail since more than one and half years and the final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Thus, it is prayed that the application of the applicant deserves to be allowed.
4] Counsel for the state has opposed the prayer.
However, it is not denied the other co-accused persons have already been granted bail by this Court.

5] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case diary and looking to the fact that the applicant has been arrested in the present case and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17411 2 MCRC-29259-2025 six other identical cases have also been registered against him in which he has already been granted bail and the fact that the other co-accused Sunil in M.Cr.C. No.29044/2024 vide order dated 30/7/2024, in the case of Bhupendra in M.Cr.C. No.36319/2024 vide order dated 10/9/2024, in the case of Rajkumar Salvi passed in MCRC.No.39749/2024 vide order dated 25/9/2024 and in the case of Rameshwar Parmar passed in MCRC.No.44082/2024 vide order dated 25/10/2024 have already been granted bail, this Court sees no reasons to keep the appliant Mohd. Jakir vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92248492/
1 behind the bars and the fact that the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time,
in the considered opinion of this Court, the applicant's application deserves to be allowed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7] MCRC stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
